name: 天主教
cue: 完整十字架、基督雕像、哥特式教堂、烛光和祈祷者；保持传统庄重的宗教艺术表现和原有衣饰。
prompt: Use case: style-transfer and conservative outpainting. ONE landscape 16:9 cinematic painting of the attached EDIT TARGET. Keep its complete original vertical field and widen naturally left and right, without cropping or stretching. Preserve all main narrative regions, distinctive people, cultural clothing, tools, creatures, architecture, tiny characteristic objects and relative scene geography. Refine photographic or CGI surfaces into fine restrained oil-painted material: subtle brush-built color planes, glazes, atmosphere and cinematic directional light. Fine strokes on faces/hands/instruments, somewhat broader marks on sky/water/masonry; no chunky paint filter or swirling expressionist sky. Keep original colors, no blanket orange/sepia. Preserve meaningful gestures, different facial identities and natural anatomy. Where source has multiple vignettes, keep every episode and use coherent painterly light and connected architecture/landscape, no added hard panel borders. No new giant portrait, labels, conceptual diagrams, logos, watermark or collage. Existing small inscriptions on objects remain natural. Retain original iconographic anatomy of deities, including canonical multiple arms when present; do not add accidental extra limbs. Preserve these characteristic original elements: 完整十字架、基督雕像、哥特式教堂、烛光和祈祷者；保持传统庄重的宗教艺术表现和原有衣饰。
visualReview: 主要叙事、主题器物、人物与画风已审阅；采用保守内容保持
